The eye-roll and gaze aversion ([6.8s-8.0s]) when mentioning a past opinion can be interpreted as a brief moment of self-consciousness. Additionally, the shift to a more rapid, higher-pitched vocal delivery ([7.9s-12.4s]) when discussing a point of personal change suggests a degree of emotional arousal. This combination of overall stability with moments of expressive reactivity supports a medium score.

The subject demonstrates a High level of Openness. The central theme of her monologue is self-reflection—acknowledging and explaining a change in her personal perspective. This willingness to re-evaluate past beliefs in light of new experiences ('Uh, yeah it is now because home girl do not have time...') is a hallmark of intellectual curiosity and openness to ideas.
